raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector, rolled out on 2026-01-17, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. Late-evening 2026-01-18 local transactions from v2 rows therefore land on 2026-01-19 between 00:00 and 06:00, which also leaves 2026-01-18 short. The fix normalizes v2 timestamps to Chicago local time, matching the legacy convention, before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
